g.text: The Issuing Provider requests Issuer registration from the TAS (REQUESTED),
and once the TAS administrator approves it (ACTIVE), the Issuer is exposed in the wallet's Issuer list.
P232-3 : Enter Claims and Create Credential Offer
The wallet performs P230-2 (Retrieve Credential Offer) ~ P230-6 (Request Credential).
Since the Credential Offer has no tx_code, the Token is requested without a tx_code.
The sub of the access_token is the Holder DID, and the Credential Issuer uses this value to
retrieve the Claims stored in P232-3 and generate the Credential.
